title: Freedom Yield Metal — Merkle DAG Snapshot v1
description: Formal contract for /api/cycles-history.json. This is the Merkle DAG SUMMARY: it publishes the two branch roots (identity_branch_root, cycles_branch_root), their combination dag_root_hash, and pointers to the leaf source JSONL documents. It is NOT the leaf data itself — for the per-cycle leaves see /api/cycle-history.jsonl (singular, validates against /api/cycle-history.schema.v1.json); for the per-key-rotation leaves see /api/identity-history.jsonl (validates against /api/identity-history.schema.v1.json). The naming convention is: .jsonl files are LEAF SOURCES (one leaf per line, append-only within schema version); .json files are SNAPSHOTS or SIGNED MANIFESTS (regenerated each run). The DAG construction rules — leaf canonical = SHA-256 of the operator-published JSONL line bytes; tree construction = Bitcoin-style odd-leaf duplicate with parent = SHA-256(raw_bytes(left) || raw_bytes(right)); dag_root_hash = SHA-256(raw_bytes(identity_branch_root) || raw_bytes(cycles_branch_root)) — are specified in docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md and are equivalent to the existing compute_merkle_root shell function at scripts/operator-local/gen-identity.sh L186-230. Schema stability: additive-only within v1.

dag_root_hash.description: 64-hex SHA-256(raw_bytes(identity_branch_root) || raw_bytes(cycles_branch_root)). The value that gets anchored on Metal A-chain via memo 'fyid1:<dag_root_hash>'. MUST equal identity.json.dag_root_hash and anchor-receipt.json.dag_root_hash for the same publication moment.

leaf_source_url.description: URL of /api/identity-history.jsonl (= the leaf source for identity_branch).

leaf_source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the leaf source document as published (raw bytes, including all newlines except the final-line trailing newline if absent). Lets verifiers cache-pin the exact JSONL bytes the branch root was computed against.

leaf_count.description: Number of leaves in this branch. Equals the number of non-empty lines in the leaf_source_url document at the moment cycles-history.json was generated. Zero means the branch is empty and branch_root equals the NULL_BRANCH_HASH sentinel SHA-256('') = 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'.

branch_root.description: 64-hex Merkle root computed over the branch leaves per docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md §3. For a single-leaf branch this equals the leaf hash unchanged.

leaf_source_url.description: URL of /api/cycle-history.jsonl (= the leaf source for cycles_branch).

anchor_receipt_url.description: URL of /api/anchor-receipt.json (= the on-chain receipt that anchored this dag_root_hash). MAY be absent before the first inscription completes.

identity_url.description: URL of /api/identity.json (= the signed manifest committing to this dag_root_hash).
